title: [MALP] Mojang added living popcorn
description: This project makes chickens act as popcorn.
body:
## What does it do?
It makes new baby chicks explode like popcorn, like in memes.

## How does it work?
It checks if the baby chicks are in a hot place and if it is they pop.
### What are hot places?
Right now they are fire/campfire or lava located under the chicks.
